coaching.headline: Our one ahead lane (The Fey mid) kept skipping the early fights — the other four kept fighting without him and lost the map. Objectives 12-28.
coaching.team: Three lanes were behind all game, but the fights show the real bleed: The Fey mid was even-or-ahead and ALIVE, yet flagged 'never joined' at the 9m, 11m, 12m and 16m fights — so the team kept opening 5-mans without their best player and losing them. The 9m river fight is a textbook bad trade: even bodies (5v5), no objective up, and we flipped a coin-toss with two players absent. Then once lanes cracked, the 20m and 22m fights had two pinned, losing lanes who couldn't help — those were the wrong fights to start. The 30m loss bought us Orb Prime, so read that one as a trade, not a throw. Two fixes: when one lane is ahead, that player shoves and rotates so we fight 5v5 with our strongest body — and don't take open-map coin-toss fights with no major up. Itemize armor too: the film flags Khaimera and Zinx with none into a physical-heavy enemy (their Murdock did 34k).
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Three lanes were behind all game, and four players kept fighting while the one ahead lane sat mid — fight after fight we were a body short of even. Get the winning lane to rotate before committing, and don't flip a no-objective 5v5; reset and take vision/farm instead.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: The Fey mid, 4/5/8 and team-high 36.6k — Mr_Meat31's lane was the only one ahead, which makes the early fights the story: Mr_Meat31 was alive and not there for the 9m, 11m, 12m and 16m fights the team lost. When ahead and pushed in, shove the wave and rotate to the fight so the team isn't a body down. The Wraith Leggings spike (~19m) is exactly when those roams hit hardest.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Zinx into Rampage offlane was theirs at every checkpoint — 5/10/3, ten deaths into a losing matchup with no item spike to swing it. By 20m and 22m Willy Guggenheim was the pinned, losing body who couldn't rotate, so the team taking fights without Zinx was on the wrong side of the numbers. Stop trading into Rampage before the items are online; farm safe and let the team group on Zinx's terms, not Rampage's.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Khaimera jungle, 3/10/2 — the Zarus matchup read theirs all game, and Cuban Noobster never finished the core (no Basilisk/Rapture) or bought armor into a 3-physical comp. Cuban was in most of the losing skirmishes; the fix is to stop forcing fights into a lead that isn't there — full-clear to the items first and reset instead of contesting a fight a body short.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Drongo carry, 2/8/4 into an even Murdock lane — even at every checkpoint means it was winnable, but eight deaths and an unfinished core (no Vanquisher/Imperator) sank it, and Goldilocks324 was flagged absent from the early fights too. Play the even lane safe, complete the core, then group — when the lane is even, the player who joins the fight first is the one who tips the numbers.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Argus support, 2/6/8 into an unfavored Aurora (theirs through 25 minutes) — behind the matchup with no spike to swing it, and Xeebs was the pinned, losing body in the 11m fight the team took without Xeebs. When the lane is losing, don't get caught out as the body down; play safe and ward so the team doesn't fight 5 with Xeebs stranded.
